{{Quote|The Valahari build some of the best ships in the galaxy.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="TCW10" />}}
'''Valahari''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that claimed neutrality in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but gave newer and advanced ships to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] that gave the CIS an advantage over the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TCW10">[[The Clone Wars 10|''The Clone Wars'' 10]]</ref>

The people of Valahari had a strong reputation for being some of the best [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] engineers in the galaxy.

==Geology, geography, flora & fauna==
Valahari's landscape included [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], [[river]]s, and canyons. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] engaged in a [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] with [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]] through a canyon. Valahari's plant life included dense groupings of trees.<ref name="TCW10" />

==History==
[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited the planet during his apprenticeship under Qui-Gon Jinn. During that time, he became acquainted with the [[House of Vane]]. At least [[22 BBY/Legends|ten years later]], Kenobi revisited the planet along with fellow [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on a diplomatic mission to try to convince the planet to stop aiding the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] through their continued manufacture of advanced starfighters. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] attended the discussion over dinner, providing counterpoints to the Jedi's accusations against the Confederacy. [[Harko Vane]], the [[King/Legends|King]] of Valahari, declined to take the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] side in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As a result, the Republic blockaded the planet.

When several unarmed ships attempted to leave Valahari, Kenobi warned Vane that if the ships continued any further, they would be disabled and boarded. Before either side could make a move, Vane's ship exploded as a result of prior sabotage by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="TCW11">[[The Clone Wars 11|''The Clone Wars'' 11]]</ref> Although flight recorders proved that the explosion was not a result of Republic aggression, the Republic information was not considered trustworthy. This event caused the outraged populace of Valahari to side with the Confederacy.<ref name="TCW10" />

[[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]], son of [[Harko Vane]], created a starfighter squadron called [[Tofen's Raiders]] to openly fight the Republic. Later, the Republic and Valahari fought one another in the [[Battle of the Hexus system]]. Both sides suffered heavy casualties, forcing Valahari to retreat.<ref name="TCW11" />

Later, the Republic fought Valahari one final time in the [[Battle of the Veil Nebula]]. The Republic attacked the Veil Nebula after it was discovered that the Veil Nebula harbored [[Harko Station]], a space station that served as headquarters for Tofen and his squad. The two sides fought again, and the battle resulted in Tofen's death and the destruction of Harko's Station. Later, Elodore Vane exiled Count Dooku from Valahari, and announced that Valahari would no longer support either side in the conflict.<ref name="TCW12">[[The Clone Wars 12|''The Clone Wars'' 12]]</ref>
